S1: F_c(a,b) = 4 r^2 det(b-a,c-a)^2 - |a-b|^2 |c-a|^2 |c-b|^2 ;  for a non-degenerate triangle  F_c >= 0  <=>  circumradius rho(a,b,c) <= r  (rho = |ab||bc||ca| / (2|det|)).
S4e_verdict: A weighting (l0,l4) of the two central constraints has vanishing deg_a=4 component only when l0=l4=0 (generic c0 != c4): the quartic hub coupling of the two faces adds, it does not cancel. Quadratics (hub norm, chain pins, localisation disks) have no degree-4 part, so no admixture of them can cancel it either.
S5d_verdict_mixed: rank 2 (verified at a rational data point) => the mixed (2,2) coupling also cannot be cancelled by any non-zero weighting (l0,l4).
L1: rho(A,b,C) <= r  <=>  b lies in exactly one of the two radius-r disks through A and C  (their centres q, q' are the two solutions of |q-A|=|q-C|=r), i.e. the crescent is the symmetric difference of the two disks.
L2: equal radii => the radical axis of the two disks is the perpendicular bisector of qq', which is the line AC. On the q-side half-plane H_q one has g_q <= g_{q'} pointwise, hence B(q',r) cap H_q IS CONTAINED IN B(q,r): the far (distal) half-disk lies in the near disk. DIRECTION MATTERS: g_q <= 0 on the q-side does NOT imply g_{q'} <= 0 (e.g. r=1, A=(-3/5,0), C=(3/5,0), q=(0,4/5), q'=(0,-4/5), p=q: g_q=-1 but g_{q'}=39/25>0). The first version of this string had the containment reversed; lead retracted C894 for it. What IS used: (a) crescent cap inside B(q,r) is B(q,r) \ int(B(q,r) cap B(q',r)), so the crescent piece in H_q lies in B(q,r); (b) the overshoot of the single-disk constraint is exactly the half-lens B(q,r) cap B(q',r) cap H_q, which lies in the distal disk B(q',r); (c) hence on any region R with R cap B(q',r) = empty, crescent <=> b in B(q,r) EXACTLY (both inclusions from the product sign g_q g_{q'} <= 0).
L3: parallelogram law: for b in B(q,r) cap B(q',r),  |b-q|^2+|b-q'|^2 <= 2r^2 and |q-m|^2+|q'-m|^2 = 2|q-m|^2 = 2(r^2-|AC|^2/4)  =>  |b-m|^2 <= |AC|^2/4, so the loss region L is inside the Thales disk of the chord AC (compact localisation of the overshoot).
